explication: LeviLauncher is an Android launcher for Minecraft Bedrock Edition. The principal workflow is: a player opens the launcher, selects an account and isolated game version, optionally manages content or modules, then the launcher prepares and starts Minecraft while maintaining foreground execution. Major branches include Microsoft account switching, APK import, worlds/resource packs, external module catalogs, news, and storage migration. Several UI-to-core links are inferred from the documented product and tree; sampled source directly confirms settings, migration, news messaging, and foreground-service behavior.
